description: Remove duplicate lines from a block of text, keeping the first occurrence of each line in its original order. Can optionally ignore letter case when deciding what counts as a duplicate. Returns the deduplicated text plus how many lines were kept and removed. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/remove-duplicate-lines/

caseInsensitive.description: Treat lines that differ only in case as duplicates (default false)

text.description: The text to deduplicate, one item per line
